description: This file defines the ExpenseProvider class which manages the state related to expenses, including fetching, updating, and deleting expenses, as well as maintaining filters and summaries.

classes.name: ExpenseProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages the state of expenses, including fetching data from repository, filtering, and CRUD operations.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the provider by refreshing the data.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches the latest expenses data, total amount, and category sums from the repository.

methods.name: setCategory
methods.description: Sets the active expense category filter and refreshes data.

methods.name: setRange
methods.description: Sets the date range filters for expenses and refreshes data.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Sets the search query filter and refreshes data.

methods.name: addExpense
methods.description: Adds a new expense via the repository and refreshes data.

methods.name: updateExpense
methods.description: Updates an existing expense via the repository and refreshes data.

methods.name: deleteExpense
methods.description: Deletes an expense by ID via the repository and refreshes data.
